subject: Remediation verification & artifact request — scope/questions + screenshots
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy.li@finnova.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin O'Neill <martin.oneill@bluecrest.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up on pen test fixes + artifacts request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the pen test summary you shared last week. Our security team (FinNova) is putting together the vendor SOC 2 addendum and we need concrete artifacts showing the fixes and compensating controls for the items listed in section 3.2 of the report. Specifically we are looking for:

- Screenshots of the admin console showing the patch applied and version numbers (or a short screencap).
- Relevant config snippets (webserver, ingress, or WAF rule example).
- Links to the ticket(s) where remediation work was tracked (Jira or equivalent).
- Brief description of any compensating controls we should be aware of (e.g., monitoring alerts, firewall rules).

Can you confirm the scope of what you can provide and an ETA? Our security lead needs these by end of next week to close our internal review (we can accept a redacted screenshot set if that helps).

Appreciate it —
Amy
Amy Li
Information Security, FinNova
amy.li@finnova.io

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@finnova.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on pen test fixes + artifacts request

Thanks Amy — will do. Looping in Neha (security) and Vivek (ops) to pull the artifacts and confirm scope. We can provide:

- Screenshot set and exported logs demonstrating the fix.
- Nginx / ingress config snippet showing the header and routing change we made.
- Jira ticket link for the remediation work.
- A short note on compensating controls (monitoring, alerting, temporary ACLs) plus retention window for logs.

Neha / Vivek — can you confirm you can assemble the ZIP of screenshots + config snippets and export the Jira ticket by COB Monday 23-Nov? If we need to redact any customer data we should call that out.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy.li@finnova.io>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on pen test fixes + artifacts request

Hi Amy / Vanessa,

Apologies for the slight delay — assembled the artifacts you requested and included short notes for each item. Attaching a ZIP with the files below and pasting the artifact inventory here for quick reference:

Attachments (in redwood_fix_screenshots_20261122.zip):
- screenshots/patch_dashboard_20261122.png — Admin console screenshot showing agent v2.4.1 applied to affected fleet (redacted tenant IDs).
- screenshots/endpoint_fix_20261122.png — Example endpoint page showing closed vulnerability flag.
- nginx-config-snippet.txt — ingress config showing the X-Frame-Options & CSP header additions and the relevant rewrite rule.
- jira-INF-7890-export.pdf — Export of the remediation ticket timeline (authors, comments, code refs).
- splunk-monitoring-query.txt — Splunk query used to alert on anomalous token-exchange patterns (thresholds noted).

Short notes / compensating controls:
- Remediation timeline: patch applied 2026-11-15; verification run 2026-11-20; regression checks completed 2026-11-22.
- Compensating controls: realtime alerting to Splunk on token anomalies (query attached), temporary egress ACLs for impacted subnets during remediation, and an extended monitoring window (30 days) with daily automated checks.
- Log retention: application request logs retained for 12 months; infra metrics retained for 13 months — searchable exports can be provided on request.

Relevant links:
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7890
- Drive folder (artifact ZIP): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDemoLink

If you need additional raw logs (we can produce obfuscated samples) or a brief walkthrough call for your security team, happy to set one up.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

From: Amy Li <amy.li@finnova.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin O'Neill <martin.oneill@bluecrest.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on pen test fixes + artifacts request

Neha — thanks for the detailed package, that looks good and should close most items in our checklist. A couple quick follow-ups before we mark this as complete:

- Could you add one more screenshot showing the Splunk alert firing (an example alert instance) so we can see the detection working end-to-end?
- For the Jira export, can you confirm that the ticket includes the code commit hash for the change? We need an auditable reference.
- You mentioned log retention windows; can you confirm the process for producing an export should auditors ask for a 12-month sample? How long does that take and who owns the request?

If you can provide the additional screenshot and a short line confirming the Jira commit hash + export process we should be able to close this week. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if that's easier.

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Amy Li
Information Security, FinNova
amy.li@finnova.io
